description: Use when you need an http security headers audit of a website or URL, with a grade and what to fix. Do not use for vulnerability scans, TLS cipher analysis or pages behind a login. Returns JSON auditing the HTTP security headers of a public URL (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, cookies) with a grade and fixes for 0.007 USDC per call. Typical response time 2500 ms (p95). Category: Infrastructure. Price: US$0.007 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

url.description: Public http(s) URL to audit, e.g. https://example.com

name: blackwood_headers_audit
title: Security headers
